findings.desc: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:591 WHY: CHK-003 promises the contract will catch L4 commands that lack a producer phase or replacement, but the new checks only verify policy presence/guidance and never prove COMMAND_POLICIES.allowedPhases stays aligned with DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS/isCommandAllowed. cli-engine.ts:1180 therefore prints lifecycle hints from a parallel table that can drift from the real gate semantics without the contract failing. severity: high
findings.dismissReason: Superseded by consolidated concept finding F-003 to avoid duplicate reviewer evidence.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/config.ts:251 HIGH - phase gating still trusts phaseTools as the authority and even returns allow-all for malformed values, so the new COMMAND_POLICIES table is advisory only. Runtime probe: isCommandAllowed("test_auto","REVIEW",{REVIEW:["test_auto"]}) === true and isCommandAllowed("bug_report","DEV",null) === true. This misses the story goal of a hard-coded lifecycle fallback. Fix: enforce COMMAND_POLICIES in isCommandAllowed/getAllowedPatterns and make config overrides only narrow, never widen, rootOnly/legacy restrictions.

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:591 WHY: the new contract only checks lifecycle policy presence/guidance and does not prove COMMAND_POLICIES.allowedPhases stays aligned with DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS/isCommandAllowed or that every L4 command has a producer phase or replacement, so cli-engine.ts:1180 can print lifecycle hints from a drifting parallel table without the contract failing. packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts:57 WHY: understanding_get/decision_get are PLAN-only, and packages/main/src/core/config.ts:143 mirrors that in phaseTools, so REVIEW reviewers cannot inspect understanding/decision through the CLI even though concept review is supposed to judge implementation against those planning artifacts. severity: high

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:483 MEDIUM - the command-policy verifier is source-text brittle: it only matches an exact `export const COMMAND_POLICIES = {` marker and single-quoted reason/replacement fields. A harmless typed export or an apostrophe in prose already demonstrates the problem (`indexOf(marker) === -1`, `/reason:/` captures only `Don`). Fix: parse the module with a JS/TS parser or broaden the extractor to tolerate typed exports and escaped quotes.

packages/main/src/handlers/test-auto.ts:84 MEDIUM - the self-project guard still tells users to run `test_story`, but this branch reclassifies `test_story` as legacy and the new lifecycle guidance points to `koala validate` + verificationEvidence instead. Runtime probe from repo root still prints that stale recommendation. Fix: align the thrown hint with the new replacement policy so blocked users are sent to the supported flow, not another deprecated command.
